The Hazards of Glass
In recent years there has been a significant increase in the number of accidents, particularly to youngsters, resulting from the greater use of large areas of glass in the home, for example, the conversion of small-paned windows into 'picture windows', the replacement of French doors with sliding glass doors, and the fixing of all glass front doors.

LIFE IN THE DEEP SOUTH

SUSI LUSS interviews MERIEL LLOYD on her visit to the Southern States of the USA

A Georgia Plantation house

MERIEL LLoyd, the EAW Membership Liaison Officer, spent an exciting month in the Southern States of America in January this year. AN able-bodied person makes a 'phone

and independence for granted and only stop

denied us for a while or we meet a severely
disabled person.

brief_context: Mentioned as a user who can now make calls easily.
brief_extract: Intercom links connect the operator with key points in the home, and the system also gives full dialling control over a loudspeaking telephone. In the time it would take to set up the tape recorder David can make a telephone call, speak to his respondent, tape the conversation and play it back to his marvelling audience! Although POSSUM was originally conceived for the use of the severely disabled such as people with high spinal injuries causing almost total paralysis, sufferers from muscular dystrophy, multiple sclerosis, poliomyelitis and cerebral palsy, many people with spastic conditions and rheumatoid arthritis also gain independence with POSSUM equipment.

at 25 Foubert's Place

Talk Back

EDITOR, SUSI LUSS, SPOKE TO THE TWO EAW HOME ECONOMISTS WHO 'MAN' THE SHOWROOM AT FOUBERT'S PLACE. Question: What type of qualifications do you need for your job?

brief_context: One of the two EAW home economists being interviewed.
brief_extract: Question: What type of qualifications do you need for your job? Hilary Leathes: The Certificate in Home Economics awarded by the National Council of Home Economics Education, which takes two to three years to get. You need 4 'O' Levels, one of which must be English in order to be accepted on the course but competition is not very hot at the moment as jobs are hard to come by and the courses are so expensive.

brief_context: One of the two EAW home economists being interviewed.
brief_extract: You have got to be really quite creative. Catherine Needham: And I also did food photography, which is preparing dishes for photographic purposes and recipe development. But then I do love cooking!

brief_context: Discussing her experiences and professional identity as a Home Economist.
brief_extract:
Catherine Needham: No, not really; there is
always someone or some organisation you can
turn to. I once had a query about a Chinese wok.

brief_context: Mentioning funny experiences and visitor confusion at the showroom.

experiences? Hilary Leathes: People do keep coming in
asking if we are the FPA (Family Planning

Women but am I allowed in?' We even get
members of the public asking us who pays our
salary.

brief_context: Operated the spout assembly line with high speed.
article_title: Up the Spout: Your Electric Kettle from Start to Finish
brief_extract: After its first press the lid is trimmed to length, shaped to ‘bulge’, ‘pipped’ (I am told that this means that the lid locks are formed), polished, pierced for the knob and finally the knob is popped on the top. Meanwhile, on a separate assembly line, operated by ladies with a speed which took my breath away, the spouts are formed twice and their seam welded. At this stage we had a finished lid, complete with knob, a lonely base, a shaped spout and a body with a hole in all the right places, namely top and bottom.

article_title: EUROPEAN CHRISTMAS: Gemütlichkeit — the German Christmas Spirit
brief_extract: Starting on December 1st and on each subsequent morning until December 24th, the child can open a miniature door on the Calendar to see a different picture of the Christmas story. On December 5th, the eve of St Nicholas Day, children in Germany hang their stockings on a door handle or leave a pair of boots or shoes near a window, in the hope that St Nicholas will reward them with presents for good behaviour during the past year. The Christmas tree originated in Strasbourg during the 17th Century (when Strasbourg was part of Germany) where small fir trees were decorated with cakes, sweets, fruit and paper.

Dutch Saint Nicholas Day
— 5th December
Christmas in Holland varies from that in England as it is purely a religious feast. However, the more light-hearted festivities and the exchange of presents take place on the feast of Saint Nicholas.

brief_context: Main figure of the Dutch Christmas tradition.
brief_extract: However, the more light-hearted festivities and the exchange of presents take place on the feast of Saint Nicholas. As this is mainly a children's celebration, they are told the tale that about two weeks before his own birthday celebrations on December 5th, Sinterklaas leaves his big palace in Madrid in Spain for Holland. He has called all his helpers — the Black Peters — or in Dutch 'Zwarte Pieten' to join him on his special steamer, loaded with presents for all good children.

by FREDERICK M. PROCTER
illustrated by Ruth Worsdell

As we sit in front of a warm fire or in our cosy centrally heated room we can spend some time in thought and look back on our gardening successes and failures for 1977. Sad to say, my prime failure was not being able to devote as much time to my garden and allotment as I would have wished.

brief_extract:
We realised the immense cost involved in generating electricity and were all determined not to grumble so much when our next electricity bill arrives! We all felt that the visit had given us a much healthier respect for the power we use so freely.'

'ELECTRICITY IN THE COMMUNITY' — LEEDS BRANCH EXHIBITION
by Miss Winifred Porter, Magazine Secretary, Leeds Branch
When members of Leeds Branch discussed their programme for the theme 'EAW in the Community', suggestions naturally centred on the local city, Leeds. We knew that at least four sales women from some of the electrical shops in the city had obtained their Home Electricity certificates through a Leeds Branch and when a local exhibition was suggested it was natural that we should bear this in mind when considering where and how it could be held.
